title: Welcome to My House!
summary: Revise rooms and common objects in a home in English.
keyIdeas: Main rooms include the bedroom, kitchen, bathroom and living room.
Rooms have typical objects, such as a bed, sofa or fridge.
Use 'in the...' to say which part of the home you are in.

activities.prompt: You sleep here at night. What room is it?
activities.explanation: The bedroom is where we sleep at night.
activities.hint: Think of the room with a bed.

activities.prompt: Match each part of the home with its Spanish name.
activities.explanation: In Spanish, kitchen is cocina, bathroom is baño, living room is salón and garden is jardín.

activities.prompt: The bed is in the kitchen.
activities.explanation: A bed is usually in the bedroom, rather than the kitchen.

activities.prompt: Complete the sentence with the correct room.
activities.hint: It is the room where we prepare food.

activities.prompt: Sort these objects into their usual rooms.
activities.explanation: The bed and pillow go in the bedroom. The sofa and television go in the living room.

activities.prompt: Lucía washes her hands at the sink next to the shower. Which room is she in?
activities.explanation: The room with a washbasin and shower is the bathroom.
activities.hint: Find the room with a washbasin and shower.

activities.prompt: Match each object with its usual room.
activities.explanation: The fridge is in the kitchen, shower in the bathroom, sofa in the living room and wardrobe in the bedroom.

activities.prompt: Put Aisha's morning routine through the house in order.
activities.explanation: First Aisha wakes up in the bedroom, then washes in the bathroom, eats breakfast in the kitchen and leaves through the front door.
items: Open the front door to go out

activities.prompt: Hugo is reading a book on the big sofa.
activities.explanation: A big sofa is usually in the living room.
activities.hint: It is the room where a family can sit and relax.

activities.prompt: Read the text and answer the questions.
activities.explanation: The bedroom is blue and Leo plays with a ball in the garden.
activities.title: Leo's House
activities.text: Leo is at home. His house is small. The bedroom is blue. The kitchen is yellow. Leo has a big green garden. He plays with a ball in the garden.

questions.explanation: The text says, 'The bedroom is blue'.

questions.prompt: Where does Leo play with the ball?
questions.explanation: The text says, 'He plays with a ball in the garden'.
